rv.q: Curtains ends up as a perfectly likeable, undeniably clever pastiche that doesn't entirely solve the mystery of why it should take the best part of three hours to get the job done.
Yet there’s a lot of filler, not enough killer.
Curtains is a show not to be missed either in London or around the UK on its tour.
Curtains has arrived not a moment too soon: cheers, not sneers, all round.
With a superb cast led by comedian Jason Manford, the new production at the Wyndham's is filled with charm and wit that makes its arrival well worth waiting for.
Visually, the piece is a real treat – colourful, exciting and above all, surprising.

This show is either a parody of, or an homage to, classic “backstage” musicals like KISS ME KATE and 42nd STREET, much loved works from the 1930s - 1950s about show biz folk and the perils of putting on a production. CURTAINS adds a murder mystery to the mix.

cn.t: This musical whodunnit delivers infectious fun with an exquisite cast led by Jason Manford, though its clever pastiche doesn't quite justify its lengthy three-hour runtime.
